finalActualTwoTabImport.scenario: Tab A opens empty history. Tab B saves 20 legal completed matches. Tab A imports an older valid replay.
finalActualTwoTabImport.beforeFix: An unrelated match added by Tab B was selected and the intended retention warning was suppressed.
finalActualTwoTabImport.afterFix: The fresh 20-match archive is displayed, the older replay gets an honest retention notice, no unrelated match is selected, and exact stored archive bytes are preserved.

bookmarkCapacity.testResult: All four full-capacity cases pass inside the 52-test focused run.

privacyAndLimits: This document includes no match states, replay payloads, private hands or hidden bot traces.
Navigation consumes existing observed historical frames and perspective labels. Practice feedback uses the public practice position.
Bookmarks are browser-local and never alter canonical completed replay exports.
Completed canonical exports remain full reproducible completed-match records; perspective-safe display does not make exported replay data a redacted public record.
This scoped report does not assert completion or results of the final whole-repository suite, AI pilot, deployment or production checks.
